entities.name: Query protein 768 aa
observations: Sequence length is 768 aa with estimated molecular mass 85.55 kDa and theoretical pI 5.66.
Pfam detects PALP at residues 7-284, tRNA-synt_1e at 316-618, DALR_2 at 664-716, and CysS_C at 727-768.

The combined tRNA-synt_1e, DALR_2, and CysS_C architecture supports a cysteinyl-tRNA synthetase-like class-I aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase assignment; the N-terminal PALP region is an apparent fusion or appended domain.
No signal peptide or transmembrane segment was reported; a soluble intracellular localization is therefore favored but not experimentally established.

Likely biological role is ATP-dependent charging of tRNA(Cys) with cysteine, supporting translational fidelity and protein biosynthesis; exact substrate specificity remains an inference from domain architecture.

Automatic annotation transfer was insufficient; closest raw Swiss-Prot-like hits showed approximately 36-37% identity over 60.4% of the query, so precise annotation is not established by homology alone.

entities.name: Cysteinyl-tRNA synthetase
observations: CysRS/CysS is a class-I aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase that forms cysteinyl-tRNA(Cys) from cysteine, ATP, and tRNA(Cys).
The query's tRNA-synt_1e, DALR_2, and CysS_C domains are characteristic evidence for a CysRS-like architecture, but the exact enzyme assignment is sequence-based rather than curated for this query.

entities.name: Cysteine tRNA charging
observations: If the CysRS assignment is correct, the protein participates in aminoacylation of tRNA(Cys), a prerequisite for accurate translation and protein biosynthesis.
The pathway/process assignment is inferred from the predicted enzyme family; no explicit pathway annotation was retrieved.
